Unlike paid services that charge monthly fees, WatchSeries provides all of its content completely free of charge. The idea behind WatchSeries is simple: great entertainment should be available to everyone, no matter where they live or how much money they have. WatchSeries makes this possible by offering a huge selection of movies and TV shows that you can stream [...] In addition to new movies, WatchSeries also stays on top of the latest TV show episodes. When a new episode of a popular series airs, WatchSeries typically has it available for streaming very quickly. This is especially great for people who follow multiple TV shows at once — instead of subscribing to several different paid services, you can watch all your shows on WatchSeries for free.
